dimensions.assessment: Affects federal personnel at the Department of Education and Department of Health and Human Services, as well as foreign medical schools seeking accreditation comparability.
dimensions.evidence: transfers specified functions relating to accreditation for foreign medical schools from the Department of Education (ED) to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).

dimensions.assessment: An administrative transfer of agency functions, advisory panels, and existing funds without changing the underlying standards of accreditation.
dimensions.evidence: The transfer of these functions does not affect any suits, proceedings, or applications for benefits

dimensions.assessment: Involves transferring existing appropriations and funds without creating a net increase in federal spending or full-time employees.
dimensions.evidence: Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall ensure that this Act does not result in a net increase in full-time equivalent employees

dimensions.assessment: Reorganizes responsibilities between two major federal departments regarding the National Committee on Foreign Medical Education and Accreditation.
dimensions.evidence: There are transferred to the Secretary of Health and Human Services ... all of the functions which the Secretary of Education exercised

dimensions.assessment: Permanent administrative restructuring taking effect six months after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: this Act shall take effect 6 months after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Exact count of personnel and dollar amounts of appropriations being transferred between the departments.
importance_detail.rationale: Transfers foreign medical school accreditation functions, personnel, and appropriations from the Department of Education to the Department of Health and Human Services without increasing overall full-time equivalent employees.
